creator: griffybit
statement: Smithing makes materials and crafts gear; click the Anvil then the production tab and start producing thread.

creator: griffybit
statement: Producing thread is the easiest way to get smithing XP for your characters.

creator: griffybit
statement: Put most production points into speed per hour to produce faster; points can also raise cap or XP.

creator: griffybit
statement: Higher production means bigger smithing XP.

creator: griffybit
statement: Archer's specialty is smithing.

creator: griffybit
statement: Mining and chopping supply materials for crafting and upgrades such as stamps.

creator: griffybit
statement: Mage is efficient at chopping.

creator: griffybit
statement: Warrior is efficient at mining.

creator: griffybit
statement: For mining you put your ores in the Forge to cook bars.

creator: griffybit
statement: Forge can be upgraded with money: multi-bar chance and capacity and extra ore slots.

creator: griffybit
statement: Three key elements for smooth World 1 progress are defense and accuracy and damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Accuracy comes from the sub-stat talent: warrior wisdom and archer strength and mage agility.

creator: griffybit
statement: Enough accuracy lets you hit mobs 100% of the time; check your accuracy percent in AFK menu bottom right.

creator: griffybit
statement: The two most prioritized talents are your sub-stat talent for 100% hit and Sharpened Ax.

creator: griffybit
statement: Sharpened Ax gives weapon power; weapon power is a stronger version of base damage.

creator: griffybit
statement: He has a separate combat guide showing all damage sources for a more advanced look.

creator: griffybit
statement: The number on the icon at the top of the portal is kills needed to unlock it and rises as you progress.

creator: griffybit
statement: Do the Scriptis questline: it gets you to World 2 and explains crafting and helps you get armor and better weapons.

creator: griffybit
statement: Blue exclamation is optional secondary quest; yellow exclamation is the story quest; always do the story quest.

creator: griffybit
statement: If taking too much damage use food like gnomwiches: inventory food tab then drag into slots to auto-heal at a health percent with internal cooldown.

creator: griffybit
statement: First purchase with a little money should be the target stamp and shield stamp from the World 1 shop.

creator: griffybit
statement: Take the stamps to Mr Piggy Bank and upgrade them with materials and money to boost defense and accuracy.

creator: griffybit
statement: Next buy the sculpting tool from the World 1 shop; drag it onto the marble to make the NPC appear.

creator: griffybit
statement: Statues are obtained from skill and combat to be used at the statue NPC for progression.

creator: griffybit
statement: Stamps also drop from skilling mobs and quests; complete the quest on at least one character to obtain all the stamps.

creator: griffybit
statement: Coliseum is at Froggy Fields; do the questline next to it for first tickets but not right away.

creator: griffybit
statement: Return to the Coliseum every day for free tickets.

creator: griffybit
statement: Portal to the party dungeon is at the bottom of the map; great place to get damage and talent points.

creator: griffybit
statement: New characters start as beginners; get to level 10 and go to Valley of the Beans for first class advancement.

creator: griffybit
statement: Want one of each class to start: Warrior and Archer and Mage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Monster kills or material farming drop cards; you start with four card slots in the Codex cards; double-click a card to equip.

creator: griffybit
statement: Collecting enough of one card type upgrades it with a star for a stronger effect.

creator: griffybit
statement: You can collect card sets but only use one set at a time.

creator: griffybit
statement: Cards show mob health and accuracy needed and damage and per-character kill counts.

creator: griffybit
statement: After crafting gear and having enough accuracy and damage go to Enroching Forest Villa for first boss Amarok; needs a key from ghost questline with one daily key.

creator: griffybit
statement: Complete the ghost quest on every character because you will farm this boss later.

creator: griffybit
statement: Door beside the ghost is the boss room door; consume the key in your inventory then redeem it at the boss room.

creator: griffybit
statement: Defeat the boss for the gem and give it to the bird at top right in main town to unlock World 2.

creator: griffybit
statement: Top of the tree in Jungle Perimeter (slimes map) has a telescope that unlocks star signs; talk to the NPC with all characters.

creator: griffybit
statement: Star signs are very important progression boost but you have limited amount to use; watch his guide before committing.

creator: griffybit
statement: Farm wooden sticks for easy cash and fast levels up to at least level 50; sell the monster materials.
